scope.note: Extension-only. Extends both 'Advanced HIV Disease' and 'AIDS' created by the HIV Production Knowledge Manifest v1 (PR #42, merged) with only what is genuinely missing. Both diseases were built by PR #42 with an identical LAB/COMPLICATION/HOSPICE_ELIGIBILITY_SUPPORT concept set, so every addition here is applied identically to both to avoid ontology drift between them.

already_present_verified.note: Every requested HIV/AIDS lab/complication/hospice-eligibility-support item was verified already present in PR #42 under an identical name on both diseases. No duplicate concept was created for any of these.

new_concepts.name: Recurrent Bacterial Sepsis
new_concepts.description: Recurrent bacterial sepsis is a recognized life-threatening complication of advanced HIV/AIDS supporting documentation of disease severity and recertification review.

new_concepts.name: Recurrent Aspiration Pneumonia
new_concepts.description: Recurrent aspiration pneumonia is a recognized life-threatening complication of advanced HIV/AIDS supporting documentation of disease severity and recertification review.

new_concepts.name: Persistent Diarrhea With Significant Weight Loss
new_concepts.description: Persistent diarrhea with significant weight loss is a recognized complication of advanced HIV/AIDS supporting documentation of disease severity and recertification review.

new_concepts.name: Antiretroviral Therapy Refused Or Discontinued
new_concepts.description: Patient/surrogate decision to refuse or discontinue antiretroviral therapy supports documentation of disease trajectory. Does not independently establish hospice eligibility -- remains dependent upon the complete documented clinical picture and physician-supported determination.

new_concepts.name: Concurrent Life-Threatening Comorbid Condition
new_concepts.description: Documents a concurrent life-threatening comorbid condition (e.g. congestive heart failure, COPD, renal failure, liver disease, dementia) alongside advanced HIV/AIDS. Does not independently establish hospice eligibility -- remains dependent upon the complete documented clinical picture and physician-supported determination.

new_applicability.concept: Persistent Diarrhea With Significant Weight Loss

functional_assessment_linkage.description: Links HIV/AIDS's existing PPS Less Than 70 Percent hospice-eligibility-support concept to the Functional Assessment Framework's PPS scale definition for full nurse-facing score interpretation, without duplicating the scale's level content.

Links HIV/AIDS's existing KPS Less Than 70 Percent hospice-eligibility-support concept to the Functional Assessment Framework's KPS scale definition for full nurse-facing score interpretation, without duplicating the scale's level content.

trend_indicators.name: PPS Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current Palliative Performance Scale score, tracked across recertification periods to document functional decline.

trend_indicators.name: KPS Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current Karnofsky Performance Status score, tracked across recertification periods to document functional decline.

trend_indicators.name: CD4 Count Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current CD4 count, tracked across recertification periods to document immunologic decline.

trend_indicators.name: Viral Load Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current HIV viral load, tracked across recertification periods to document disease progression.

trend_indicators.name: Weight Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current weight, tracked across recertification periods to document nutritional decline.

trend_indicators.name: Complication History Trend
trend_indicators.description: Frequency/severity of major opportunistic infections and complications, tracked across recertification periods.

trend_indicators.name: Hospitalization Trend
trend_indicators.description: Frequency of hospitalization, tracked across recertification periods to document disease severity.

trend_indicators.name: ART Status Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current antiretroviral therapy status (e.g. adherent, declined, discontinued), tracked across recertification periods.

trend_indicators.name: Narrative Trend
trend_indicators.description: Free-text nurse narrative summarizing overall clinical decline across recertification periods, supporting but never replacing physician-supported prognosis determination.
